title: Poki for Developers - Reach the world on web

observations.statement: Poki's developer landing page reports 100 million monthly players.
Poki reports more than 5 million monthly players per high-performing game.
observations.excerpt: With more than 5 million monthly players per high-performing game, your game is sure to find its perfect audience.

observations.statement: Poki reports more than 1 billion gameplays per month.
observations.excerpt: 1B+ gameplays per month The biggest audience in web gaming, open to developers of all sizes.

observations.statement: Poki describes itself as the leading web gaming platform, powered by 500+ game developers.
observations.excerpt: Poki is the leading web gaming platform, powered by a community of 500+ game developers.
